_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

opened_day.basis: day of October the service opened to anyone

opened_year.basis: year the service opened to anyone

first_riders_day.basis: day of February the first public riders were taken

creek_day.basis: day of April the car washed into Salado Creek

recall_filed_day.basis: day of May the recall report was received

interim_by_day.basis: day of April by which every affected vehicle had the interim update

days_creek_to_open.basis: days from the car in Salado Creek to the service opening to anyone

days_creek_to_recall.basis: days from the car in Salado Creek to the recall report

days_first_riders_to_open.basis: days from the first invited riders to the service opening to anyone

days_recall_to_open.basis: days from the recall report to the service opening to anyone

days_first_riders_to_creek.basis: days from the first invited riders to the car in Salado Creek

month_rows.basis: posts per month row, February 24th to October 14th inclusive, one post per day

posts_total.basis: posts in the calendar field, both end days included

creek_post_index.basis: zero based index of the April 20th post in the field

recall_post_index.basis: zero based index of the May 1st post in the field

creek_same_day_as_interim.basis: the interim update deadline and the creek are the same date

units_affected.basis: potentially affected units in the recall, the federal record's own figure

service_sq_mi_feb.basis: square miles of the San Antonio service area in February

cities_feb.basis: cities that took first public riders on February 24th

cities_open_oct.basis: cities opened to anyone on October 14th: San Antonio, San Diego, Tampa

generations_recalled.basis: generations named in the recall: 5th and 6th

incidents_april.basis: flood incidents in April that Texas Public Radio reports, one per claim
